I don’t usually leave reviews, but the way this surgery is run, especially the medication side, is beyond unacceptable. It’s shocking that someone with that attitude is allowed to deal with patients and their families.

There always seems to be an issue with prescriptions not being processed correctly or delays in medication. For vulnerable patients this is incredibly dangerous, yet the clerk shows no care or urgency at all. On more than one occasion medication has been missed because of her incompetence, and instead of helping, she becomes argumentative and tries to make it sound like everyone else is at fault.

The medication clerk at this surgery is without doubt the rudest and most incompetent person I have ever dealt with. She is consistently condescending and dismissive, and I have no idea how she has managed to keep her role given the damage her behaviour causes.

Every single month there are problems obtaining my nan’s medication. This should not be a battle—especially when my nan is extremely vulnerable. Due to the negligence of this surgery, and in particular the medication clerk, she has been left without essential medication for several days on multiple occasions.

I have had numerous unpleasant interactions with her, and each time she has been rude, argumentative, and unwilling to listen. On one occasion, she even tried to gaslight me by insisting I was confused about my nan’s prescription and not managing it correctly. I asked her to investigate further, and only later that day did she call back to admit she was wrong—yet no apology was offered for her earlier behaviour.
